slides.title: Gaining Access
slides.html:
You have many options about joining a instance:

  • Scanning a QR Code (Opens the next page straight away)
  • Link (Opens the next page straight away)
  • Link + Manual Code (Opens page on the left) Use whatever method is in use with your organization.

slides.title: Callsign
slides.html:
• Give yourself a callsign. This should be something only your organization can identify you with.
  • It will be used across all services.

slides.title: Waiting Room
slides.html:
• Show your QR code to an admin or share the link with them.
  • Once an admin has approved you, you will be able to continue.

slides.title: Instructions
slides.html:
• Deploy App has built in instructions to instruct users and highlight key features.
  • This guide will go through certificate installation.

slides.title: Download the certificate
slides.html: • This will act as your way to access the services.

slides.title: Install your certificate
slides.html:
• Your callsign acts as your password.
  • Type it and press OK until you are back in Deploy App.

slides.title: Login the certificate
slides.html:
• Press "Navigate with your key".
  • When prompted to choose a certificate, check that your callsign is selected and press "Select" to login.

slides.title: Success
slides.html:
• Now you can start using apps.
  • Deploy App shows you some instructions the first time, or you can look at the instructions on this wiki.
